purpose: Define the exact numerical statistics, permutation counts, seeds and evaluability rules used by the already-frozen v5 cascade before any terminal 200-species image is opened.

colour_surface_v1.scope: Reuse its Lab vector, geometry thresholds, season sensitivities and qualified environmental overlay null only; do not inherit the superseded v3 ordered inference tree.

shared_transition_preimage_result.scope: method gate only, not biological support

frozen_colour_field.standardization: Within each species, subtract the median and divide by IQR componentwise over the complete admitted terminal analysis subset; zero-IQR components are set to zero after centering; all-zero-IQR species are not_evaluable.

species_conditioned_spatial_organization.species_statistic: negative arithmetic mean of RMS Euclidean Lab discontinuity across retained coordinate-only kNN edges; larger values mean stronger local colour similarity/spatial organization
species_conditioned_spatial_organization.species_weight: one equal vote per evaluable species
species_conditioned_spatial_organization.pooled_statistic: arithmetic mean of species statistics over every evaluable species in all eight frozen cohorts
species_conditioned_spatial_organization.cohort_statistic: arithmetic mean of species statistics within each frozen cohort
species_conditioned_spatial_organization.null: synchronized complete three-component Lab-vector permutations independently within every species, with all graphs and admission fixed
species_conditioned_spatial_organization.monte_carlo_p: (number of null pooled statistics >= observed pooled statistic + 1) / 10000
species_conditioned_spatial_organization.cohort_direction: observed cohort statistic minus its permutation-null median
species_conditioned_spatial_organization.supported: pooled p<=0.05 and at least 6 of 8 cohort directions are positive
species_conditioned_spatial_organization.unsupported: all eight cohorts and the pooled statistic are evaluable but the supported rule is not met
species_conditioned_spatial_organization.not_evaluable: the terminal measurement completeness gate fails, fewer than 20 species are evaluable in any cohort, fewer than 160 species are evaluable overall, or the pooled statistic/null cannot be computed

shared_transition.species_cell_score: mean within-species zero-to-one average-rank edge discontinuity among retained edge midpoints in each detectable cell
shared_transition.high_cell_rule: for each species choose exactly ceil(0.1 * detectable_cells) highest-scoring detectable cells, at least one; break exact score ties deterministically by ascending cell_id
shared_transition.cell_statistic: standardized excess number of high-transition species relative to the frozen species-by-cell opportunity expectation
shared_transition.pooled_statistic: maximum cell statistic over every prospectively valid pooled 100-km cell
shared_transition.cohort_statistic: the same maximum scan computed separately within each frozen C01-C08 species subset using its own frozen opportunity reference
shared_transition.real_colour_null: for each replicate, permute complete standardized Lab vectors independently within every species, recompute edge discontinuities, within-species ranks, cell scores, high cells and the maximum scan; the scan is inside the null
shared_transition.monte_carlo_p: (number of null pooled scan statistics >= observed pooled scan statistic + 1) / 10000
shared_transition.cohort_direction: observed cohort scan statistic minus its real-colour permutation-null median
shared_transition.supported: pooled p<=0.05 and at least 6 of 8 cohort directions are positive
shared_transition.unsupported: the pooled scan and all eight cohort scans are evaluable but the supported rule is not met
shared_transition.not_evaluable: the preimage method gate is not pass, the spatial branch is not supported, any required cohort scan is not evaluable, or the real-colour null cannot be completed

environmental_concordance.prerequisite: run confirmatorily after species_conditioned_spatial_organization=unsupported, or after shared_transition=unsupported; never after not_evaluable
environmental_concordance.qualified_null: weighted Moran eigenvector coefficient-sign randomization after frozen broad geographic detrending
environmental_concordance.familywise_control: one joint maximum null over every declared cohort/equal-cohort, role, scale, season and primary/sensitivity environmental surface from colour_surface_v1
environmental_concordance.supported: at least one of the three 100-km all_dates equal-eight-cohort primary flower tests has familywise-adjusted p<=0.05
environmental_concordance.unsupported: all three primary family tests are evaluable and all familywise-adjusted p-values are >0.05
environmental_concordance.not_evaluable: the existing environmental input/coverage/cohort evaluability rules fail

pollinator_biogeographic_concordance.current_consequence_if_reached: return not_evaluable and terminate; do not substitute a post-colour pollinator source or derive pollinator regions from flower colour

publication_ceiling: The terminal atlas can support spatial organization, a shared cross-species transition, or concordance with independently frozen environmental boundaries according to the reached v5 branch. None of these camera-space analyses alone establish calibrated reflectance, pollinator perception, visitation, adaptation, selection or causation.
